title: Shout
prompt: Return the text in capital letters with an exclamation mark on the end. "hi" becomes "HI!".
starter:
func solve(text: String) -> String:
	return text
hint: There is a method for uppercase. Call it, then join the exclamation mark.
solution:
func solve(text: String) -> String:
	return text.to_upper() + "!"
